pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be3 e5 7.Nb3 Be6 8.Qd2
pages.notes: Plan 4 named White's g4 as a Black move. Reworded plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.f4 e5 7.Nf3 Nbd7 8.a4 Be7 9.Bd3 O-O 10.O-O exf4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ne3 with no knight able to reach it and claimed the e-file for White, whose e4-pawn blocks it (reviewer). Rewrote plan 1 around Bxf4, the half-open f-file and the weak d6-pawn.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.f4 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...Nb6 controlling e5 and a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.f4 Qc7 7.Nf3 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Qe1-g3 route; plan 2 had a ...b7-b5-b4 route; plan 3 sent the d7-knight to f8, where the bishop stands. Rewrote plans 1-3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Bg5 e5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...g5 with the bishop on g5 and a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plan 2 (second wording after the reviewer noted Black usually recaptures on f6 with a piece).

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Bg5 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 used ...0-0 notation and a ...b5-b4 route; plan 3 had ...g5 with the bishop on g5. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling in the overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Bg5 Nbd7 7.Bc4 e6 8.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Qe1-g3 route; plan 4 rerouted a b8-knight already on d7 and sent it to f8, where the bishop stands. Rewrote plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Najdorf Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...Rxc3 with the bishop on c8; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Reworded both.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6...e6 7.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 4 had a Qd1-e1-g3 route through the f2-pawn; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote both.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6...e6 7.Qd3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the c6-knight to e5 via b8-d7. Rewrote plan 4; reworded plan 2.
